notes.title: Time For Crime - RELEASE!
notes.notes:
As of this post, the game is now live! Go and claim what is meant to be yours from the many vaults around idle city!

For instant support and bug reports join the discord server:
https://discord.gg/QY5SKBa

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Planned Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello! Progress on the game is going well to help us achieve a planned release date of:

Friday June 1st, 2018 @ 12:00pm PDT

Here's a look at the city for the intro cut-scene!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32746844/ea2347455cdfa991e15c00fc1ce3106d4d75db17.png[/img]

Thanks for your continued support.
